q.name: Cultivation of Spirit

description.normalized: Spirit Charge (Passive): Attacks deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+20% AP) magic damage; When not active, launching an attack grants 1 Unleash. Attacking again refreshes Unleash's duration. Max Unleash is 6. If the duration is not refreshed, Yunara loses 1 Unleash every 0.5 seconds. Spirit Unbound (Active): On cast, consumes Unleash, gaining 22% / 35% / 47% / 60% Attack Speed for 5 seconds. Attacks are empowered during this time to: Deal an additional 10 / 15 / 20 / 25 (+20% AP) magic damage on-hit; Spread to enemies nearby the target, dealing them 18 (30% AD) physical damage. Transcendent State: This ability automatically activates until Yunara exits the state. If the attack Critically Strikes, its spread damage will also Critically Strike. Damage from spread attacks is increased to 250% against minions below 30% Health.

w.name: Arc of Judgment / Arc of Ruin

description.normalized: Arc of Judgment: Lets rip a spinning prayer bead in the target location, briefly granting vision of the area it travels through. The prayer bead slows enemies hit by 99%, lingering as it travels and resetting its remaining duration. When it reaches its endpoint, it lingers and expands for 1 second, regardless of whether it has hit an enemy. The initial hit deals 60 / 110 / 160 / 210 (+85% bonus AD +50% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds; When lingering, the bead deals an additional 8 / 14 / 20 / 26 (+12% bonus AD +7.5% AP) magic damage to nearby enemies every 0.25 seconds. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Arc of Ruin. Arc of Ruin: Fires a laser in the target direction that deals 160 (+120% bonus AD +75% AP) magic damage and slows by 99%, decaying over 1.5 seconds. Arc of Judgment deals 50% - 100% damage to minions and executes low-Health minions.

e.name: Kanmei's Steps / Untouchable Shadow

description.normalized: Kanmei's Steps: Gains 30% / 35% / 40% / 45% Movement Speed for 1.5 seconds, increased to 45% / 52.5% / 60% / 67.5% when moving toward a visible enemy champion nearby. While Yunara is in a Transcendent State, this ability is upgraded to Untouchable Shadow. Untouchable Shadow: Dashes in the target direction.

r.name: Transcend One's Self

description.normalized: Passive: Arc of Ruin's base damage and Untouchable Shadow's dash speed scale with this ability's level. Transcendent State (Active): Enters a Transcendent State for 15 seconds. During this time, Yunara's basic abilities are empowered and cost no Mana. Cultivation of Spirit: Activates automatically for the duration. Arc of Judgment: Upgrades to Arc of Ruin. Its remaining cooldown reduces by 80% when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State. Kanmei's Steps: Upgrades to Untouchable Shadow. Its cooldown refreshes when Yunara enters or exits a Transcendent State.
